fact: On 4-5 December 2023 the INS and UNFPA held a technical workshop in Kinshasa with the ministries of health, interior and justice and civil registry offices on producing vital statistics from civil registration, which adopted a roadmap (methodological guide, coordination committee, data sharing, action plan); the INS deputy director said birth registration is incomplete and 80% of births are not captured in some localities, and the article says the national statistical system still struggles to produce birth, death, marriage and divorce statistics; no publication from any administrative source is stated.
title: Enregistrement des faits d'état civil et Production de statistiques vitales : UNFPA et ses partenaires y travaillent
